native_contract.effective_charm_field: WORD character +0xAC consumed directly by both _buy_item and _sell_item

buy.formula: floor(floor(base_or_scaled_base * (markup + 100) / 100) * (110 - floor(Charm / 5)) / 100), with >100000 BUY scale/restore around the integer stages
buy.rounding: native integer truncation at each DIV; no floating/VB final rounding

scope_note: This closes the BUY/SELL Charm pricing callsites themselves. Universal cross-category ordering that produces the current/effective Charm field remains tracked separately under character modifier-order assertions.
megamud_compatibility: Imported MegaMUD executable inventory contains ordinary `buy %s` and `sell %s` command templates; pricing remains server-authoritative on the normal terminal stream.
borin_compatibility: Borin must not calculate or override Classic shop price from a private formula path; the server quote/transaction remains authoritative.
